description: Whether Excel reads its clock once per recalc (T-3116): Calc!A1 = NOW(), B1 = slow work that depends on A1 (a 1,000,000-cell SUM(SEQUENCE) plus a 150x150 MAKEARRAY of LAMBDA calls), C1 = NOW() after B1, D1 = C1=A1, E1 = their difference in ms; A2 = the same inside one LET (A3 its ms difference); A4 = NOW() on another sheet after B1 equals A1 (Other!A2 the difference); A7 = AND(B1>0, D1). These are FALSE / 20-50 ms on every excel-graph fill (Excel reads its clock per call), but a fixed harness clock cannot show it, so they are recorded, not scored. Scored (invariant): A5 = NOW()-NOW()=0 (two reads in one 10 ms tick) and A6 = INT(TODAY())=INT(NOW()).
